gold.note: Light mode value. Dark mode uses gold-bright (#f5c518).

gold-bright.note: Dark mode accent and CTA gradient start.

amber.note: Light mode gradient partner to gold. Dark mode uses amber-bright.

amber-bright.note: Dark mode gradient partner. CTA gradient end.

bg-light.note: Light mode base background. Tinted cream — not white.

bg-dark.note: Dark mode base background. Near-black with blue-violet undertone.

display.purpose: Hero headlines and marquee statements. One per page. Always Oswald, uppercase, letter-spaced.

headline.purpose: Section headers, quiz step titles. Oswald uppercase.

title.purpose: Card titles, modal headers, emphasized UI labels. Manrope bold.

body.purpose: Paragraph text, descriptions, feature copy. Max 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Chips, nav items, badges, table headers. Manrope semibold.

shadows.name: card-ambient-light
shadows.purpose: Content card lift in light mode. Soft and diffuse.

shadows.name: card-ambient-dark
shadows.purpose: Content card lift in dark mode. Deeper and more atmospheric.

shadows.name: cta-glow-rest
shadows.purpose: Gold warmth under CTA button at rest. CTA variant only.

shadows.name: cta-glow-hover
shadows.purpose: CTA button hover. The button appears to levitate.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default state transitions: buttons, borders, colors, nav links.

motion.name: ease-deliberate
motion.purpose: Progress dots and theme transitions. Slightly slower for weight.

components.name: CTA Button
components.description: Primary action button. Gold-to-amber gradient. Used for quiz start, recommendations, key conversions.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f5c518, #ff9f1c); color: #09090f; padding: 16px; width: 100%; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(196,149,10,0.3), 0 2px 8px rgba(196,149,10,0.15); transition: opacity 0.2s ease-out, box-shadow 0.2s ease-out, transform 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-cta:hover { opacity: 0.9; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(196,149,10,0.4), 0 4px 16px rgba(196,149,10,0.2); } .ds-btn-cta:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-cta:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary action. Solid gold background. Used for secondary confirmations.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { background: #c4950a; color: #0d0d1a; padding: 16px; width: 100%; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-default:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-default:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary action. Transparent with subtle border. Used for dismissals, secondary options.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #424260; padding: 16px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.09); border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease-out, border-color 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #0d0d1a; border-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.14); } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Standard content container. Movie results, feature items, information blocks.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.09); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px 20px 14px; box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.14); } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.65; color: #0d0d1a; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field. Quiz answers, search, form inputs.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.09); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #0d0d1a; width: 100%; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6a6a88; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(196,149,10,0.5); }

components.name: Navigation Header
components.description: Sticky frosted-glass header with logo and nav links.
components.html:
PopChoice
HomeQuiz
components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 20px; background: rgba(247,245,238,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06); } .ds-nav-logo { font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f5c518, #ff9f1c); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #6a6a88; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 12px; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease-out, background 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #0d0d1a; background: rgba(196,149,10,0.06); } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #8c6300; background: rgba(196,149,10,0.1); }

components.name: Progress Dots
components.description: Quiz step indicator. Dots morph between states — shape change is the signal.
components.css: .ds-progress { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-dot { height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; transition: all 0.3s ease-out; } .ds-dot--complete { width: 24px; background: rgba(245,197,24,0.5); } .ds-dot--active { width: 24px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f5c518, #ff9f1c); } .ds-dot--inactive { width: 8px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.09); }

narrative.overview:
The neighborhood cinema where the staff loves movies as much as you do. Not a multiplex algorithm churning thumbnails, not a streaming service with 400+ options — a room with good chairs, warm light, and a poster on the wall that makes you feel something before the lights even go down. PopChoice occupies this space: confident, curated, quietly thrilled about film.

The system operates in two modes — warm parchment light and cool midnight dark — both theater-appropriate, both treated as equals. Neither is an afterthought. The interface uses Oswald's cinematic authority for headlines and Manrope's warm approachability for everything conversational. Gold appears where it counts: on what you should do next, on what's been chosen, on what matters. Everywhere else, it rests.

Playfulness is earned through texture and motion, not decoration. The animated mascot, the morphing progress dots, the gold glow on the CTA — these are moments, not a mood board. The product should feel fun and unusual enough to be memorable, and immediately legible from a glance.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-theme: warm parchment light and cool midnight dark — both intentional, both equal
Gold as signal, never noise — the accent appears on exactly what matters
Oswald uppercase authority paired with Manrope warm approachability
Restrained surface depth: flat at rest, depth earned by state
Motion in service of feedback, not spectacle

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold appears on ≤10% of any given screen in its full-value form. Its rarity is what makes it read as signal. Gold tints exist for hover backgrounds — those are not accent uses.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Extremes Rule
rules.body: Never #000000 or #ffffff. Director's Ink (#0d0d1a) and Ghost White (#f8f8ff) are the terminals. Every neutral is tinted toward the brand hue.

rules.name: The Uppercase Authority Rule
rules.body: Oswald is always uppercase and letter-spaced (minimum 0.04em). Lowercase Oswald defeats its purpose entirely.

rules.name: The Single Display Rule
rules.body: One Display-level element per page. Hierarchy collapses when everything shouts.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The card shadow is a quiet hint, not a statement. Only the CTA carries an expressive shadow.

rules.name: The Gold Glow Rule
rules.body: The gold-tinted shadow exists only on the CTA button. Do not apply --pc-cta-shadow to cards, chips, nav items, or decorative elements.

rules.name: The No-Nested-Cards Rule
rules.body: Cards do not contain cards. Use tinted backgrounds or borders for inner containers, never a nested card.

dos: Do use gold on ≤10% of any given screen in its full-value form — CTAs, active states, progress indicators, the logo.
Do use Oswald uppercase with letter-spacing at minimum 0.04em on all display and headline text.
Do maintain warm parchment light mode and cool midnight dark mode with equal visual care.
Do apply the gold glow shadow exclusively to the CTA button variant.
Do animate state changes with 200ms ease-out. Progress dots use 300ms for deliberate weight.
Do cap body copy at 65–75ch line length.
Do treat solo and group mode entry points with equal visual weight on the landing page.
donts: Don't copy streaming platform aesthetics: dark backgrounds with red or blue accents (Netflix, Disney, Max).
Don't use Amazon-style 'you might also like' card grids — transactional, invisible, soulless.
Don't over-design into heavy editorial film-festival territory — alienating, prioritizes aesthetic over instant comprehension.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient) on anything except the logo wordmark.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards, list items, or callouts.
Don't use Oswald in lowercase or without letter-spacing.
Don't layer gold on gold. One gold-role element per visual cluster.
Don't use #000000 or #ffffff — Director's Ink (#0d0d1a) and Ghost White (#f8f8ff) are the terminals.
Don't build identical-sized card grids with icon + heading + paragraph repeated in a uniform grid.
